_metadata.purpose: Define the machine-enforced evidence bar for a bounded architecture/platform/system design maturity claim.
_metadata.claim_boundary: This standard permits only a design/spec maturity claim. It does not permit deployed scale, runtime SLO achievement, compliance certification, production readiness, or product completeness claims.

design_spec_maturity_claim_rule.exact_claim: Oyatie’s architecture, platform, and system design are specified to a hyperscaler-grade design maturity bar.
design_spec_maturity_claim_rule.claim_scope: design/spec maturity only: architecture, platform, and system design surfaces are complete enough for implementation-ready review

operational_maturity_claim_rule.claim_boundary: Operational/product/runtime hyperscaler maturity remains blocked until implementation, deployment, load, compliance, incident, and observed SLO evidence all pass separate operational gates.
current_blockers: masterplan implementation lanes still contain pending, scaffold, or stub implementation-plan states
this standard validates design/spec surfaces only and intentionally excludes runtime SLO achievement evidence
this standard intentionally excludes compliance certification and production-readiness evidence

required_surfaces.name: Product requirements document
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has PRD.md at the service root.

required_surfaces.name: Machine-readable service manifest
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has manifest.json at the service root.

required_surfaces.name: Implementation plans
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has at least one IP-*.md implementation plan anywhere under the service directory.

required_surfaces.name: ADR links or local decisions
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has manifest.adrs entries or service-local decisions/ADR-*.md files.

required_surfaces.name: OpenAPI contract
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has an OpenAPI YAML/JSON contract.

required_surfaces.name: AsyncAPI contract
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has an AsyncAPI YAML/JSON contract.

required_surfaces.name: proto3 contract
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a .proto file declaring syntax = "proto3".

required_surfaces.name: Capability catalog
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has at least one file under capabilities/.

required_surfaces.name: Cedar or policy surface
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a .cedar policy or a policy/ artifact.

required_surfaces.name: SLO specification
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a YAML/JSON SLO artifact under slos/.

required_surfaces.name: Runbook
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has at least one Markdown runbook under runbooks/.

required_surfaces.name: Threat model
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a threat-model Markdown artifact.

required_surfaces.name: Failure modes
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a failure-modes Markdown artifact.

required_surfaces.name: Data residency
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a residency, sovereign, regional-pack, or multi-region policy artifact, or manifest regulatory_packs evidence.

required_surfaces.name: Cost and FinOps model
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has a cost or FinOps artifact.

required_surfaces.name: Audit and evidence emission
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has an audit/evidence artifact or manifest audit_chain evidence.

required_surfaces.name: Tenant isolation
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has tenant, isolation, or RLS policy evidence.

required_surfaces.name: Operational boundaries
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has incident, capacity, backfill, multi-region, or operational-boundaries evidence.

required_surfaces.name: Implementation-ready acceptance criteria
required_surfaces.evidence_policy: Each microservice has Markdown acceptance criteria.

title: Design/spec maturity claim evidence standard
purpose: Define the machine-enforced evidence bar for a bounded architecture/platform/system design maturity claim.

_meta.authority_boundary: Allows design/spec maturity claims only; does not authorize operational, production, certification, SLO-achievement, or product-completeness claims.

hyperscaler_grade_rigor.named_precedent: AWS Well-Architected review and Google production-readiness-review style claim gating: design claims require explicit evidence and do not imply runtime readiness.

failure_modes.mode: design claim inflated into production readiness
failure_modes.expected_behavior: forbidden_claim_patterns and operational_maturity_claim_rule block the claim

failure_modes.mode: required surface missing for one microservice
failure_modes.expected_behavior: gate emits evidence gap and claim remains blocked for that surface

failure_modes.mode: stale evidence reused after corpus changes

hyperscaler_grade_rigor.rollback_path: Remove or narrow the exact_claim until required surfaces are green again.
hyperscaler_grade_rigor.versioning: Additive schema evolution under schema_version oyatie.design-spec-maturity-claims.v1; breaking claim semantics require ADR update.
